description: The Velocity Weakening joint model is similar to a slip-softening model, except that friction reduces as a function of increasing velocity rather than slip distance. Based on the standard Mohr-Coulomb joint model. Documented in the official 9.7 THEORY section only (no command-reference page); this file was authored 2026-08-14 from that page + live 3DEC 9.7.47 enumeration (the 9th jmodel in 'block contact jmodel assign ?').

property_groups.name: Properties
property_groups.description: Joint properties for the 'velocity-weakening' joint constitutive model. Assign with 'block contact jmodel assign velocity-weakening [range ...]', then set with 'block contact property <keyword> <value> [range ...]'.

properties.description: Current friction angle in degrees (read only per the official theory page; the live engine accepts writes).
Shear displacement at which the joint ceases to dilate.
Exponent a in the friction-velocity law.
Reference velocity v* in the friction-velocity law.
Plastic shear displacement (3D VECTOR - the live engine expects a 3-component value; state variable).
Shear velocity magnitude v in the friction-velocity law (state variable).
Set true to use plastic shear velocity in the friction-velocity law. Default false (live engine expects a boolean).

source: Official 9.7 theory page 'Velocity Weakening Joint Model In 3DEC' + live 3DEC 9.7.47 enumeration
verification: Live-verified 2026-08-14 on 3DEC 9.7.47: property set enumerated via the wrong-property-name error after 'block contact jmodel assign' (exact match with this file unless noted).
